description_en: Removes tags from keys or secrets
description_zh: 为密钥或凭据解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun kms untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type key --resource-id key-hzz62f1cb66fa42qo0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the resource.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601478.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601478.html查看当前阿里云账号的可用地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource from which you want to remove tags. Valid values:

key
secret
parameters.help_zh:
要解绑标签的资源类型。取值：

key：密钥

secret：凭据
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from resources. Valid values:

true
false (default)

This parameter takes effect only when you specify an empty tag key
parameters.help_zh:
是否为资源解绑所有标签。取值：

true：是

false（默认值）：否

仅当传入的标签键（TagKey）为空时，该参数生效
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the resources from which you want to remove tags. You can enter up to 50 resource IDs.

Enter multiple resource IDs in the `["ResourceId.1","ResourceId.2",...]` format
parameters.help_zh:
要解绑标签的资源ID列表，最多可以输入50个资源ID。

输入多个资源ID时，格式为`["ResourceId.1","ResourceId.2",...]`
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The keys of the tags that you want to remove. You can enter up to 20 tag keys.

Enter multiple tag keys in the `["key.1","key.2",...]` format.

The tag key cannot start with aliyun or acs:
parameters.help_zh:
要解绑的标签的标签键，最多可以输入20个标签键。

输入多个标签键时，格式为`["key.1","key.2",...]`。
标签键不能以aliyun和acs:开头
parameters.name: tag_key

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
